# Choose the level of personalization that fits your business
Deliver dynamic, data-driven experiences that adjust to each user — across every touchpoint, at every stage of their journey.
[ Request demo ](https://www.algolia.com/demorequest?utm_cta=personalization)

#####  Personalization redefined
Personalization isn’t one-size-fits-all. It’s a spectrum of curation and automation. Algolia gives you precise control over how personalization works, from weighting attributes based on your business priorities to automatically calculating affinities from user behavior across the journey.
Whether helping users discover or decide, your experience reflects their evolving intent—not just past behavior—and guides them toward the next best action.
As experiences become more conversational and interactive, personalization becomes the foundation that allows them to respond intelligently to each user.
##  A full spectrum of personalization
##### Personalize the whole user journey
Deliver consistent personalization across Search, Browse, and Recommend. Create a cohesive experience that reflects each user’s preferences at every step.
##### Combine control with automation
Apply business rules or granular weights where you need precision, and rely on machine learning to scale personalization across users. You decide where automation takes over and where control stays in your hands.
##### Built for every team
Developers can integrate through APIs, while business teams can manage and refine experiences directly in Merchandising Studio. 
##### Activate your data across channels
Enrich user profiles with data from tools like Segment, Shopify, and Google BigQuery, and use those insights to inform experiences beyond search.
#####  Personalization that responds in the moment
Personalization works best when it reflects what users are doing right now, not just what they’ve done before.
Algolia captures in-session behavior and adjusts experiences in real time as intent becomes clearer. As users browse, refine, or even start a conversation, results update to stay relevant.
  * Reduce friction by showing more relevant results sooner
  * Keep users engaged as their intent evolves
  * Increase conversion by responding to real-time signals


[ Learn more ](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/personalization/advanced-personalization/what-is-advanced-personalization/in-depth/real-time-personalization-and-historical-personalization#real-time-personalization)
#####  From rules to one-to-one relevance
At one level, Personalization is guided by rules. Teams define segments, apply business logic, and maintain control over how results are shaped.
At a more advanced level, Personalization becomes individual. Preferences are learned from each user’s interactions, allowing results to reflect affinities like brand, price, or category.

##  Algolia Personalization FAQs 
How does personalization improve search results?  0
Personalization adapts search results based on each user’s behavior, preferences, and past interactions. This means returning the most relevant products or content faster, reducing bounce rates and boosting conversion. 
What kind of data powers personalization?  0
We use behavioral data like clicks, searches, page views, purchases, and engagement patterns. All data is anonymized and processed in real time to tailor the experience for each visitor. 
How does real-time personalization work?  0
Real‑time personalization dynamically adjusts search results (and other discovery experiences) as each user interacts with your site—right within their current session. It uses immediate signals (e.g. clicks, navigation, searches) while the user is browsing, not just past history, and evolves and adapts to understand user intent. First‑time or anonymous users are still covered: even without a recorded profile, real‑time behavior can help tailor the experience. [Learn more on our docs](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/personalization/advanced-personalization/configure/setup/enable-real-time-personalization/). 
Does personalization work across all touchpoints?  0
Yes. Personalization applies across search, category pages, homepage recommendations, and even product detail pages—creating a consistent, optimized experience at every step of the customer journey.
Can we personalize category or collection pages, too?  0
Absolutely. Personalization can reorder or prioritize products on category pages based on each visitor’s preferences and behavior—helping them find what they’re looking for faster. 
What role does personalization play in increasing conversions?  0
Personalized experiences reduce friction in the customer journey. When users find relevant products more quickly, they’re more likely to convert, repurchase, and stay loyal. 
Can personalization be tailored to different segments or audiences?  0
Yes. You can create personalization strategies for different user segments—like new vs. returning visitors, or high-value customers—ensuring the experience aligns with each group’s needs. 
How does personalization handle new or anonymous visitors?  0
Even without login data, we personalize experiences using session-based signals like search terms, clicks, or category visits to surface relevant results from the very first interaction. 
Is personalization customizable to fit our business goals?  0
Definitely, whether your priority is increasing AOV, boosting discovery, or reducing bounce rates, you can fine-tune personalization strategies to align with your specific KPIs.

#####  Personalization redefined
Personalization isn’t one-size-fits-all. It’s a spectrum of curation and automation. Algolia gives you precise control over how personalization works, from weighting attributes based on your business priorities to automatically calculating affinities from user behavior across the journey.
Whether helping users discover or decide, your experience reflects their evolving intent—not just past behavior—and guides them toward the next best action.
As experiences become more conversational and interactive, personalization becomes the foundation that allows them to respond intelligently to each user.

##### Personalize the whole user journey
Deliver consistent personalization across Search, Browse, and Recommend. Create a cohesive experience that reflects each user’s preferences at every step.
![](https://www.algolia.com/files/live/sites/algolia-assets/files/icons/filters.svg)
##### Combine control with automation
Apply business rules or granular weights where you need precision, and rely on machine learning to scale personalization across users. You decide where automation takes over and where control stays in your hands.
![](https://www.algolia.com/files/live/sites/algolia-assets/files/icons/code.svg)
##### Built for every team
Developers can integrate through APIs, while business teams can manage and refine experiences directly in Merchandising Studio. 
![](https://www.algolia.com/files/live/sites/algolia-assets/files/icons/plusincircle.svg)
##### Activate your data across channels
Enrich user profiles with data from tools like Segment, Shopify, and Google BigQuery, and use those insights to inform experiences beyond search.
#####  Personalization that responds in the moment
Personalization works best when it reflects what users are doing right now, not just what they’ve done before.
Algolia captures in-session behavior and adjusts experiences in real time as intent becomes clearer. As users browse, refine, or even start a conversation, results update to stay relevant.
  * Reduce friction by showing more relevant results sooner
  * Keep users engaged as their intent evolves
  * Increase conversion by responding to real-time signals

#####  From rules to one-to-one relevance
At one level, Personalization is guided by rules. Teams define segments, apply business logic, and maintain control over how results are shaped.
At a more advanced level, Personalization becomes individual. Preferences are learned from each user’s interactions, allowing results to reflect affinities like brand, price, or category.

##  Algolia Personalization FAQs 
How does personalization improve search results?  0
Personalization adapts search results based on each user’s behavior, preferences, and past interactions. This means returning the most relevant products or content faster, reducing bounce rates and boosting conversion. 
What kind of data powers personalization?  0
We use behavioral data like clicks, searches, page views, purchases, and engagement patterns. All data is anonymized and processed in real time to tailor the experience for each visitor. 
How does real-time personalization work?  0
Real‑time personalization dynamically adjusts search results (and other discovery experiences) as each user interacts with your site—right within their current session. It uses immediate signals (e.g. clicks, navigation, searches) while the user is browsing, not just past history, and evolves and adapts to understand user intent. First‑time or anonymous users are still covered: even without a recorded profile, real‑time behavior can help tailor the experience. [Learn more on our docs](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/personalization/advanced-personalization/configure/setup/enable-real-time-personalization/). 
Does personalization work across all touchpoints?  0
Yes. Personalization applies across search, category pages, homepage recommendations, and even product detail pages—creating a consistent, optimized experience at every step of the customer journey.
Can we personalize category or collection pages, too?  0
Absolutely. Personalization can reorder or prioritize products on category pages based on each visitor’s preferences and behavior—helping them find what they’re looking for faster. 
What role does personalization play in increasing conversions?  0
Personalized experiences reduce friction in the customer journey. When users find relevant products more quickly, they’re more likely to convert, repurchase, and stay loyal. 
Can personalization be tailored to different segments or audiences?  0
Yes. You can create personalization strategies for different user segments—like new vs. returning visitors, or high-value customers—ensuring the experience aligns with each group’s needs. 
How does personalization handle new or anonymous visitors?  0
Even without login data, we personalize experiences using session-based signals like search terms, clicks, or category visits to surface relevant results from the very first interaction. 
Is personalization customizable to fit our business goals?  0
Definitely, whether your priority is increasing AOV, boosting discovery, or reducing bounce rates, you can fine-tune personalization strategies to align with your specific KPIs.

#####  Personalization redefined
Personalization isn’t one-size-fits-all. It’s a spectrum of curation and automation. Algolia gives you precise control over how personalization works, from weighting attributes based on your business priorities to automatically calculating affinities from user behavior across the journey.
Whether helping users discover or decide, your experience reflects their evolving intent—not just past behavior—and guides them toward the next best action.
As experiences become more conversational and interactive, personalization becomes the foundation that allows them to respond intelligently to each user.
##  A full spectrum of personalization
##### Personalize the whole user journey
Deliver consistent personalization across Search, Browse, and Recommend. Create a cohesive experience that reflects each user’s preferences at every step.
##### Combine control with automation
Apply business rules or granular weights where you need precision, and rely on machine learning to scale personalization across users. You decide where automation takes over and where control stays in your hands.
##### Built for every team
Developers can integrate through APIs, while business teams can manage and refine experiences directly in Merchandising Studio. 
##### Activate your data across channels
Enrich user profiles with data from tools like Segment, Shopify, and Google BigQuery, and use those insights to inform experiences beyond search.
#####  Personalization that responds in the moment
Personalization works best when it reflects what users are doing right now, not just what they’ve done before.
Algolia captures in-session behavior and adjusts experiences in real time as intent becomes clearer. As users browse, refine, or even start a conversation, results update to stay relevant.

  * Keep users engaged as their intent evolves
  * Increase conversion by responding to real-time signals

First‑time or anonymous users are still covered: even without a recorded profile, real‑time behavior can help tailor the experience.
